name: com.everylot/everylot
title: Everylot
description: Search used cars on dealer lots from your agent: listings near you, what a model costs, price drops.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search dealer listings in plain words, optionally near a US zip or city/state. Returns vehicle facts, asking and previous prices, location, seller, page URLs and supported median asking-price comparisons. Comparisons match year, make, model, trim, state, a fixed 20,000-mile band, drivetrain, fuel and sale condition. They need eight cars at two other dealers, excluding this seller and VIN. Missing facts mean no assessment. Asking prices are not valuations. Physical condition, history, options and fees can differ. Confirm price and availability with the dealer. For good deals use sort=best_deal; unassessed cars rank last. Page through with page; get_listing gives full details. Cite page URLs.

query.description: Plain words: make, model, body type, fuel, "under 25k", a year.

near.description: A US zip, or a city and state ("Tampa, FL"), or a state name.

radius.description: Miles from the place; 30 if left out.

price_max.description: Highest asking price in US dollars.

sort.description: best_deal ranks supported comparison gaps; unassessed last. Default: nearest with a place, newest without.

page.description: Which page of results, each `limit` long.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full vehicle facts, current/previous asking price, seller, location and page URL, by listing id.

id.description: The id from a result, or its page URL.

tools.name: market_prices
tools.description: Model asking prices: median, range, listing/dealer counts, weekly/monthly drops, year averages and cheapest cars. Optional state filter. Not a vehicle valuation.

state.description: US state name or code; omit for all covered states.

tools.name: price_drops
tools.description: Advertised price drops in the last seven days, largest first. Returns old/new prices and listing URLs. Optional state, city or zip radius.

near.description: US zip, state, or city/state; omit for all coverage.

radius.description: Miles from a zip; 30 if left out. Ignored for a city or state.

limit.description: How many price drops to return.

tools.name: dealer_lot
tools.description: Find a dealer by name, slug or host. Returns inventory count, asking-price range/median, weekly drops, newest cars and page URL.

dealer.description: Dealer name, Everylot dealer slug, or website host.

limit.description: How many of the newest cars to return.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Everylot used-car listings for use as a research source. Returns document ids, titles and URLs; read one with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one document returned by search, by its id, with its full text and source URL.
